//: ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING and this rule must stay LAST.
Vercel applies every matching rule, and for a repeated header key the
last match wins. This block used to sit ABOVE the catch-all, so the
catch-all's 'max-age=0, must-revalidate' overwrote it and every hashed
asset was revalidated on every visit - observed live on
/assets/index-*.js. A content-hashed filename cannot go stale, so it
should never be revalidated: a changed file is a different URL.
Only Cache-Control is overridden here; the security headers above
still apply to /assets/ because that rule matched first.
Verify after deploy: curl -I on any /assets/*.js must say immutable.
